device._instruction: Add all devices used to capture this raster-based image.

colorDepth._instruction: Enter the number of bits used to represent the color of a single pixel or voxel in this image.

dataLocation._instruction: Add the location of the file in which this raster-based image is stored.

dimension._instruction: Enter the dimensions of this raster-based image for two-dimensional spaces as [x, y] or for three-dimensional space as [x, y, z].

resolution._instruction: Enter the size of a single pixel as [x, y] or voxel as [x, y, z] of this raster-based image.
